threats.title: An adversary can gain unauthorized access to Azure Postgres DB instances due to weak network security configuration
threats.description: An adversary can gain unauthorized access to  Accounting PostgreSQL instances due to weak network security configuration
threats.mitigation: Mitigation applied: Restrict access to Azure Postgres DB instances by configuring server-level firewall rules to only permit connections from selected IP addresses where possible with risk reduction 100 % Restrict access to Azure Postgres DB instances by configuring server-level firewall rules to only permit connections from selected IP addresses where possible. Refer: https://aka.ms/tmt-th153

threats.title: An adversary may read and/or tamper with the data transmitted to Azure Postgres DB due to weak configuration
threats.description: An adversary may read and/or tamper with the data transmitted to Accounting PostgreSQL due to weak configuration
threats.mitigation: Mitigation applied: Enforce communication between clients and Azure Postgres DB to be over SSL/TLS by enabling the Enforce SSL connection feature on the server with risk reduction 100 % Enforce communication between clients and Azure Postgres DB to be over SSL/TLS by enabling the Enforce SSL connection feature on the server. Check that the connection strings used to connect to MySQL databases have the right configuration (e.g. ssl = true or sslmode=require or sslmode=true are set). Refer: https://aka.ms/tmt-th154a Configure MySQL server to use a verifiable SSL certificate (needed for SSL/TLS communication). Refer: https://aka.ms/tmt-th154b

threats.title: An adversary can gain long term, persistent access to an Azure Postgres DB instance through the compromise of local user account password(s)
threats.description: An adversary can gain long term, persistent access to Accounting PostgreSQL instance through the compromise of local user account password(s)
threats.mitigation:
Mitigation applied: It is recommended to rotate user account passwords (e with risk reduction 100 %
It is recommended to rotate user account passwords (e.g. those used in connection strings) regularly, in accordance with your organization's policies. Store secrets in a secret storage solution (e.g. Azure Key Vault)

threats.title: An adversary can gain access to sensitive data by performing SQL injection through Web API
threats.description: SQL injection is an attack in which malicious code is inserted into strings that are later passed to an instance of SQL Server for parsing and execution. The primary form of SQL injection consists of direct insertion of code into user-input variables that are concatenated with SQL commands and executed. A less direct attack injects malicious code into strings that are destined for storage in a table or as metadata. When the stored strings are subsequently concatenated into a dynamic SQL command, the malicious code is executed
threats.mitigation: Mitigation applied: Ensure that type-safe parameters are used in Web API for data access with risk reduction 100 % Ensure that type-safe parameters are used in Web API for data access. Refer: https://aka.ms/tmtinputval#typesafe-api

threats.mitigation: Mitigation applied: Ensure secure management and storage of Azure storage access keys with risk reduction 100 % Ensure secure management and storage of Azure storage access keys. It is recommended to rotate storage access keys regularly, in accordance with organizational policies. Refer: https://aka.ms/tmt-th63

threats.title: An adversary can abuse an insecure communication channel between a client and Azure File Storage
threats.description: An adversary can abuse an insecure communication channel between a client and Azure File Storage
threats.mitigation: Mitigation applied: Ensure that communication to Azure Storage is over HTTPS with risk reduction 100 % Ensure that communication to Azure Storage is over HTTPS. It is recommended to enable the secure transfer required option to force communication with Azure Storage to be over HTTPS. Use Client-Side Encryption to store sensitive data in Azure Storage. Refer: https://aka.ms/tmt-th65

threats.title: An adversary can deny actions on Azure File Storage due to lack of auditing
threats.description: Proper logging of all security events and user actions builds traceability in a system and denies any possible repudiation issues. In the absence of proper auditing and logging controls, it would become impossible to implement any accountability in a system
threats.mitigation: Mitigation applied: Use Azure Storage Analytics to audit access of Azure Storage with risk reduction 100 % Use Azure Storage Analytics to audit access of Azure Storage. If possible, audit the calls to the Azure Storage instance at the source of the call. Refer: https://aka.ms/tmt-th20
